common.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select the text and copy it by hand.
common.tryAgainLater: Try again in a little while.

insecure.title: This connection is not secure
insecure.text: Over plain HTTP, downloads are held in memory instead of streaming to disk, and an upload that breaks off cannot resume. Open this page over HTTPS for large files.

home.claim: Into the castle it goes. Only the recipient gets in.
home.drop: Drag files in, paste or pick them. We're not fussy.
home.trust: Nobody can peek into your files. Pinky promise, encrypted with maths.

resume.title: Unfinished upload
resume.text: An upload stopped before it finished. Pick the same files again and it carries on where it left off.
resume.wrongFiles: These are not the files of the unfinished upload. Pick exactly the same ones.

gate.title: Upload password
gate.text: Whoever runs this castle asks for a password before anyone can send files. Links you get still open without it.
gate.wrong: That password did not work. Try again?

options.filesHint: Every file is encrypted in your browser before it leaves.
options.expiryHint: After this time the files are deleted from the server.
options.downloadsHint: Once deletes the files right after the first download.
options.passwordHint: The recipient needs it as well as the link. Send it another way.
options.passwordShort: Use at least 8 characters, so the password holds up against guessing.
options.metadataHint: Camera details and the GPS position come out of JPEG photos before encrypting.
options.emptyHint: Add some files to send them.

upload.cancelQuestion: Stop the upload? Nothing is shared, and the parts already sent are deleted.
upload.failed: The upload did not go through. Try again?
upload.limit: You have sent as much as this server takes for now.
upload.quota: The server has no room left for these files.
upload.tooLarge: These files are larger than this server takes.
upload.noResume: Resuming after a reload needs HTTPS. Over this connection, an upload that breaks off starts over.

done.title: Share link
done.hint: Anyone with this link can open the files until they expire.
done.noteHint: Anyone with this link can read the note until it expires.
done.qrSaved: QR code saved as a PNG
done.manageHint: Keep this one to yourself. It deletes the share before it expires.

receive.title: Shared with you
receive.lastDownload: This is the last download. The files are deleted afterwards.
receive.saveFolderHint: Writes every file into a folder you pick, without a zip.
receive.noPreview: No preview for this kind of file
receive.previewLimited: No previews here, since each one would count as a download.
receive.tooLarge: Too large to preview. Download it to open it.
receive.previewFailed: The preview did not load. The download still works.
receive.lockedText: The sender locked these files with a password. They should have sent it to you separately.
receive.wrong: That password did not open the files. Check it and try again.
receive.decryptedHere: Decrypted in this browser. The server never sees the files.
receive.failed: The download did not work. Try again?
receive.busy: The last download of this share is running right now. If it breaks off, it can still be finished, so try again later.
receive.tooMany: Too many wrong passwords or too many requests.

note.title: Write a note
note.hint: The note is encrypted in your browser and shared like a file.
note.label: Note
note.tooLong: That note is too long for one share.
note.receivedHint: Reading it counts as a download, like saving a file.

gone.expiredText: The sender chose a time, and it has passed. Ask them to send the files again.
gone.burnedText: These files could be downloaded a set number of times, and that number is used up. They are gone from the server.
gone.missingText: This link leads nowhere. The share may have expired, been used up or deleted, or a letter got lost while copying the link.
gone.nokeyText: The part of the link after the # holds the key, and it did not arrive. Ask for the whole link again.

manage.title: Manage share
manage.deleteHint: Removes the files and the link right away.
manage.deleteQuestion: Delete this share now? The link stops working for everyone, and this cannot be undone.
manage.deletedText: The files and the link are gone.
manage.deleteFailed: Deleting did not work. Try again?
manage.notFoundText: This management link is incomplete, or the share has already expired or been deleted.

request.title: Ask for files
request.intro: You get two links. Whoever has the request link can send you files, and only your collect link opens them.
request.warning: Anyone with the request link can upload to it, so give it only to the people you ask.
request.expiryHint: After this time the request and everything sent to it are deleted.
request.maxUploadsHint: How many times files can be sent to the request.
request.maxSizeHint: In megabytes per upload, counted after encryption, which adds up to about 12% to the files.
request.requestLinkHint: Send this link to whoever should send you files.
request.collectLinkHint: Keep this link to yourself. Nothing else opens what arrives.
request.failed: The request could not be created. Try again?

send.title: Someone asked you for files
send.intro: Your files are encrypted in this browser. Only the person who asked can open them.
send.cap: This request takes up to {size} per upload, counted after encryption, which adds up to about 12% to the files.
send.sentText: Only the person who asked can open it.
send.closedText: It does not take any more uploads.
send.notFoundText: This request has expired, or the link is incomplete.
send.tooLarge: That is more than this request takes, which is {size} after encryption.
send.busy: Too many uploads to this request are running right now. Try again once one of them has finished.

collect.title: Files sent to you
collect.emptyHint: Whatever is sent through the request link shows up here.
collect.unreadableText: Anyone with the request link can send something that no key opens. Delete it.
collect.deleteFailed: Deleting did not work. Try again?
collect.closeHint: Deletes the request and everything sent to it.
collect.closeQuestion: Close the request now? Everything sent to it is deleted, and this cannot be undone.
collect.closedText: Everything sent to it is deleted.

general.rememberHint: Expiry, download limit and metadata come back the next time you send.
general.expiryHint: What a new share starts with.
general.metadataHint: Switched on for every new share that holds JPEG photos.
general.pasteHint: Files you paste anywhere on the page are picked up, such as a screenshot. Text pasted on the start page opens a note.
general.quietHint: Leaves out routine confirmations. Problems still show.
general.celebrateHint: A short burst of colour when the link is ready.

look.themeHint: System follows the device and switches with it.
look.oledHint: Pure black behind the dark theme, for OLED screens.
look.cornersHint: How round every card, button and field is.
look.motionHint: Off keeps everything still. Wild lets the castle show off.
look.buttonsHint: Words, words with a symbol, the symbol alone, or the word on hover.
look.accentHint: The colour of what is active or chosen.
look.rainbowHint: Every card and control takes its own colour.
look.reactiveHint: Colours rest in grey and light up under the pointer.

oled.refusal: OLED only darkens {dark}, or {system} while the device is dark. With {light} chosen it has nothing to do.

builds.serverHint: CastleParcel runs as one small container on your own server.
builds.phoneHint: A phone app is planned. Until then the page installs as an app from the browser.

info.versionHint: A number opens its release notes.
info.report: Problems, wishes or suggestions? You're welcome to open an issue on GitHub, or send an email.
info.bugSaved: Bug report saved, with no passwords or keys inside
info.body: A one-knight crusade: good-looking open-source tools that did not exist in the shape I wanted, built until nothing is missing. It is free, with no accounts, no telemetry, no ads and no paid tier. No asterisk anywhere. Nothing readable ever leaves your own walls. Forged on evenings and weekends, with heart and stubbornness.
info.coffee: If CastleParcel has earned a place on your server or computer, toss a coin to your knight: it helps cover the costs and keeps the project alive. It also makes this knight's heart beat a little faster. Three ways below, whichever suits you.
info.appeal: Toss a coin to your knight: it covers part of the costs and keeps the project alive. Everything I build costs nothing and shows no ads.
info.coffeeText: Buy Me a Coffee takes cards and Apple Pay or Google Pay. The page opens in a new tab.
info.paypalText: PayPal opens in a new tab, with or without an account.
info.cryptoText: Pick a currency, then send to the address it shows.
